decisions.reason: As a small, close-to-core burner component, it likely has low carrying cost and supports the installed radiant-heater business, so the option value of keeping it exceeds the benefit of an early withdrawal.

Because this electric infrared panel line is a flagship tied to the firm’s strategic direction and launched only recently, management is likely to keep investing while market uncertainty is still resolving.

This electric halogen infrared heater is less clearly strategic and may overlap with other electric heating offers, but with no clear failure signal yet the firm is still more likely to keep the option open for another year.
An industrial electric infrared hall-heater line fits the firm’s core industrial customer base well, and in a growing firm and market it is likely to be retained while adoption evidence accumulates.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is both strategically central and highly aligned with the firm’s lower-carbon direction, so its growth-option value is very high relative to dropping it now.
